in_sanskrit.name: सत्तु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The fundamental essence or nature of things, the underlying reality, the absolute truth.

in_hindi.name: सत्तु
in_hindi.long_meaning: सत्य का अर्थ, सत्य का धर्म, सत्य का साथ, सत्य का रूप - Truth, the meaning or essence of truth, the path or support of truth, the form or manifestation of truth.

in_tamil.name: சத்து
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆத்மவிசயம் அல்லது சத்தம் - The nature or essence of the self or the absolute, the reality or truth.

in_telugu.name: శత్తు
in_telugu.long_meaning: ఆధ్యాత్మ అయ్యధ్యమ్ - The ultimate reality or truth, the self or the absolute.

in_marathi.name: Sattu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, pure, true
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sattu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sattva is a Sanskrit term that represents good, pure, and true. It is one of the three gunas (qualities or energies) in Hinduism. Sattu is derived from Sattva.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, pure, true
in_bengali.long_meaning: Sattu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Sattva is a Sanskrit term that represents good, pure, and true. It is one of the three gunas (qualities or energies) in Hinduism. Sattu is derived from Sattva.
